''See also: [[vital aura Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Vital aura is the fundamental energy of the natural world, acting as a pervasive power that permeates the heavens and the earth. It is described as having no beginning or end, existing as a unified whole that takes on various specific aspects depending on its environment. These aspects include elements such as fire, water, wind, earth, light, dreams, blood, death, [[hunger]], and destruction. While it is a singular force, it manifests in diverse ways, such as the green of life or the red of heat. In the progression of [[sacred arts]], vital aura serves as a critical resource for practitioners. Individuals at the [[Copper stage]] possess open spirits that allow them to harvest and cycle this environmental energy into their own [[madra]], providing a more expansive and effective power source. This process of [[cycling]] aura is essential for strengthening the body and spirit, as well as fueling various techniques. Beyond sentient beings, vital aura is absorbed by plants over long periods to develop rudimentary spirits and is the foundation for natural spirits like [[Sylvan Riverseed|Sylvan Riverseeds]]. It also powers magical constructs and can be manipulated through resonance or [[scripts]] to achieve specific effects, such as gathering energy or pushing it away.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|At the [[Copper stage]], practitioners gain the ability to cycle vital aura from both heaven and earth. This energy responds to sword resonance and can be sensed by those possessing [[Copper]] senses. While [[sacred beasts]] refine this substance into [[madra]], vital aura itself functions like the [[madra]] of the natural world and eventually returns to its source. During certain events, a rainbow of vital aura has been seen rising over the pyramid, and specialized mining mechanisms have been known to draw the energy in from the surrounding region.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[vital aura|Vital aura]] responds to sword resonance.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c3">''Soulsmith'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[sacred beast|Sacred beasts]] refine [[vital aura]] into [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c4">''Soulsmith'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[vital aura|Vital aura]] is like the [[madra]] of the natural world and returns to its source.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c4" />}}</li>
